data.revised_prompt:
Create a polished high-quality 2D game attack concept preview illustration using the provided references: use the first jellyfish character only for Soft Candy's identity, palette, glow, and glossy translucent gummy material; use the second cat avatar only as the target player avatar portrait style and scale reference.

Composition: centered, large, readable single player avatar portrait medallion, cute fantasy game style similar to the cat portrait reference. No enemy portrait, no Soft Candy portrait, no attacker portrait, no long-distance travel path, no tentacle stretching between characters. No text, labels, UI buttons, cards, scene background, grid, borders, or watermark.

Attack effect: exactly TWO short translucent gummy jellyfish tentacles whip across the centered player avatar in a close-range slap. The tentacles arc in from the upper-left and upper-right edges of the avatar area toward the avatar face/body, crossing over the portrait surface like soft neon candy ribbons. They are short, elastic, glossy, semi-transparent lavender-blue with cyan inner cores, pink-violet highlights, rounded paddle tips, tiny bubble beads, and small candy glints. They must read as cute jellyfish tentacles, not ropes, snakes, claws, arms, spikes, horror anatomy, or weapons.

Impact language: clear playful damaging whip hit directly on the avatar itself, with small aqua-white slap flashes, curved motion smears, tiny bubbles, and a gentle violet ripple hugging the portrait medallion. Avatar remains visible underneath; FX overlays it without hiding it completely.

Style: clean HD 2D game FX, project-native ocean fantasy style, crisp silhouettes, polished glow, transparent jelly gummy material, bright but not overexposed, centered compact effect suitable as a local Sprite2D overlay over the player avatar. Transparent/empty background feel.
